business_summary: Hefei SeeYa Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, production, and sale of OLEDoS displays. The company offers various OLEDoS displays, such as , 1.3", 1.03", 0.83", 0.72", 0.6", 0.49", and 0.32"; and OLEDoS optics solutions, such as  Pancake, Lens group, Birdbath, and Waveguide. Its products are used in various industrial equipment, such as smart manufacturing, infrared thermal camera, medical equipment, education, simulation training, security, and services; as well as consumer usage, such as AR, VR, mobile viewing, mobile office, and EVF. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Hefei, China with an additional office in Shanghai, China.

AR, VR, 모바일 시청, 모바일 오피스, EVF 등 소비자 활용 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 2016년에 설립되었으며 중국 허페이에 본사를 두고 있으며 중국 상하이에 추가 사무실을 두고 있습니다.
